claim: Since the 2022 vintage Pinot Noir may also be bottled as a red at Hengst, Kirchberg de Barr and Vorbourg.
because: Only Hengst and Kirchberg de Barr were admitted for Pinot Noir from the 2022 vintage (Journal Officiel, 13 May 2022). Vorbourg was added later, by the arrêté of 4 July 2024 amending the Alsace Grand Cru cahier des charges (published 7 July 2024), and applies from the 2024 vintage.
fix: Pinot Noir may also be bottled as a red at Hengst and Kirchberg de Barr since the 2022 vintage, and at Vorbourg since the 2024 vintage.
